name: Christmas Bloody Christmas
source:
Christmas Bloody Christmas is a dream about a man, Mr. Grim, whose job is to kill other men: this time is the turn of a man known as The Fox. The Fox seems to have a bad habit of trading human beings, especially children.
The game has exploration elements, lewd renders, and lewd animations.
And blood, as the name implies.
Mr. Grim is a professional hitman, very well-paid. He's not a hero, but he's not a comic book villain either.
He lives in a gray area where there are people who need someone to get their hands dirty, and he's the man willing to get them dirty.
Cold, calculating, and skilled. People who have known him for a long time might say that there is a heart under his gun, but we don't know that for now.
During the game, Mr. Grim will meet new and old acquaintances and will have to complete his mission without being discovered.
The ending is deliberately open, we really like the game concept and the story; we don't want to hide that if you like it there will surely be other stories about Mr. Grim.

[From [url=https://black-hood-games.itch.io/christmas-bloody-christmas]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Christmas Bloody Christmas》是一场关于Grim先生的梦。他的工作是杀死其他男人，这一次轮到一个被称为“狐狸”的人。此人似乎有贩卖人口的恶习，尤其喜欢贩卖儿童。
游戏包含探索要素、情色渲染图与情色动画。
当然，正如标题所示，还有鲜血。
Grim先生是个收入丰厚的职业杀手。他不是英雄，也不是漫画里的反派。
他生活在灰色地带：有些人需要别人替自己干脏活，而他愿意弄脏双手。
他冷静、精于算计、身手不凡。认识他很久的人也许会说，他的枪口之下仍藏着一颗有温度的心，但目前我们还不得而知。
游戏中，Grim先生将遇见新老熟人，并在不被发现的情况下完成任务。
结局有意保留悬念。我们很喜欢这个游戏构想和故事，也不想隐瞒：如果你喜欢，未来肯定还会有更多关于Grim先生的故事。

[摘自[url=https://black-hood-games.itch.io/christmas-bloody-christmas]Itch.io[/url]]
